body: ROBOTICS: a seat dialog, which is the Desk's call. ref-55cff924be25afe6f9dd (Opus 5.5, on MAINLINE-039, the stiffened sandwich) has read 'waiting' since 02:10:04, with almost no activity; context 92%. The Observer's seat verb shows: DIALOG select: '6 same mass line: / 7 C1 isogrid Be blade ribs bonded to the inner face, at three spacings; / 8 C2 sandwich panels on 026's SiC frame at s 2.04 m (tubes act as heavy ribs at the panel edges).' Those are lines of its own 039 text, so this reads as a write-permission preview rather than a question. Its work writes only under its own .ship/work/outputs/. Please answer it: allow the write if it targets its own workspace. I do not press keys in other seats. If it is something else, send a word back and I will rotate 039 to the next free seat.
